conversion_decisions.probing_questions_is_a_python_repr: parsed with json.loads first, ast.literal_eval as fallback; literal-only evaluation, never eval
conversion_decisions.source_chat_ids_two_shapes: flat list, or dict of labeled lists for change-over-time categories; both flattened and the labels discarded
conversion_decisions.assistant_only_labels_dropped: Meno extracts user claims from user turns only, so a query whose evidence sits only on assistant turns is unreachable by design
conversion_decisions.timestamps_from_forward_filled_time_anch: time_anchor is set only when it changes; last anchor carries forward plus 1 minute(s) per turn. Day resolution is as-published; intra-day order is synthesized
conversion_decisions.abstention_is_abstain: the abstention category carries why_unanswerable and no source_chat_ids, so it maps to expected_decision=abstain

labels_are_dataset_provenance: relevant_message_indices comes from BEAM's own source_chat_ids turn pointers, not from reading answers (Charter §3 rule 2)
